s: Alle haben Angst vorm schwarzen Mann
All have fear (are afraid) of the black man
Angst.et: From Middle High German angest, from Old High German angust, from Proto-Germanic *angustiz.

s: He, Angsthase! Traust dich wohl nicht?
Angsthase.et: From Angst (“fear”) + Hase (“hare”). The compound could simply be based on the hare’s flight instinct, but is usually thought to be an alteration of unattested *Angsthose, from Hose (“trousers, pants”); compare German Bangbüxe, Dutch bangebroek, English scared…
